pull-request-footer: Release review: check the current PR head in the Prepare release workflow before merging. Merging publishes an early-preview GitHub release, then builds and tests both container architectures before attaching deployment assets. Review the [upgrade and rollback guide](https://github.com/crs48/feedme/blob/main/docs/releases.md) and add release-specific compatibility notes to the changelog. Real Habitat and Stripe acceptance remains outstanding; this release is not a production-readiness claim.
